answer.reason: The keys of STANDING_OF_QUOTE are the five CovernestQuoteState values copied exactly, one for one, and the core looks up the raw vendor text (quote.insurerState) by them. Nothing in the domain's text names these five states. The distinction the domain needs is the coarser standing (uncovered / in_review / covered), which the core works out itself, so the vendor's own states sit in the application
